scope: Frozen-policy local goal navigation on real-source assets in simulation; no physical sim-to-real claim
eligibility_gates: verified source group and use history
known metric scale with calibration record
legal local use and paper-image permissions reviewed
collision surface and scan holes audited
pose/goal channel compatible with approved interface

initial_segment_rules.selection: Among independently eligible, timestamp-ordered source camera subtrajectories, take the earliest nonoverlapping segment in each turn stratum. Freeze all IDs/poses/hashes before checkpoint evaluation. Missing timestamps or valid route evidence blocks automatic selection.
initial_segment_rules.scan_holes: No shortcut through missing observations. Open-surface unsigned distance alone is insufficient to identify the intended interior; require audited region boundaries and source observations.

success: No earlier terminal failure and goal reached within tolerance and budget
progress: D(start, goal)-D(final, goal) using a frozen obstacle-aware estimator on the independently audited admissible domain; otherwise null with reason. Never substitute Euclidean distance silently.
path_efficiency: For successful episodes only, reference obstacle-aware shortest-path length divided by executed trajectory length. Name approximation, grid resolution and domain; do not substitute clearance-weighted A* length as Euclidean optimum. Record all failures separately.
blocking_reasons: No currently untouched eligible physical source group
Actual platform actor/actions and policy checkpoint not supplied
preparation_vs_training: Existing inspection/crops are known preparation. Actual use for geometry fitting or policy training remains separately UNCONFIRMED; do not infer either from file existence.
raw_data_release: No raw third-party model or self-acquired scan is published by this protocol.
